training_data: FineWeb-Edu sample-10BT (365M chars) + FineMath finemath-4plus (50M chars); no code
known_limits: no code/JSON in training text: JSON tool calls cost ~15-20% more tokens than GPT-2/Llama-2 tokenizers
digits are single tokens; a leading space before a number is its own token
Hindi/Devanagari is out of scope and tokenises inefficiently
rule: Do not retrain, reorder or insert special tokens for this model. A change means a new tokenizer and a new pretraining run.
